UrNzKCUGo7oK(Y[~fFay.text: Help the cat win the spelling bee by turning him into a spelling champ! When the user types in a word, have the cat spell out each letter (wait 1 second between each letter)Use the blocks in "Operators" to find the length of the word that the user typed in, and find a specific letter in the word. Hint - you will need a repeat loop, and you will need a counter variable to keep track what letter you're currently at. Use the "1 key pressed, 2 key pressed..." events to set up the following spellings:1. Normal spelling: S-N-A-K-E2. Spell all but first letter: N-A-K-E3. Spell all but last letter: S-N-A-K4. Spell all but first and last: N-A-K5. Spell every other, starting with 2nd: N-K6. Spell every other, starting with 1st: S-A-E7. Spell backwards: E-K-A-N-S

-K97vFilKs](*Z+Jn0)d.text:
1. When 1 is pressed, ask the user for a word and spell out the word letter by letter. e.x. C-O-D-I-N-G
2. When 2 is pressed, ask the user for a word and spell out all but the first letter. e.x. O-D-I-N-G
3. When 3 is pressed, ask the user for a word and spell out all but the last letter. e.x. C-O-D-I-N
4. When 4 is pressed, ask the user for a word and spell out all but the first and last letters. e.x. O-D-I-N
5. When 5 is pressed, ask the user for a word and spell out every other letter. e.x. C-D-N
6. When 6 is pressed, ask the user for a word and spell out the word backward. e.x. G-N-I-D-O-C
